# dw-review: PR #1065 final fix commit `391da5d7` (issue #1078)

**Target:** `git diff fc3bc348...391da5d7`, 26 files, the single commit `fix(withdrawals): close review safety and edge gaps` that answered the 19 findings of the seven pre-merge review lanes. Squash-merged to main as `f8e75277` on 2026-10-30 with no GitHub review. Reviewed 2026-10-30 in a detached worktree at `391da5d7a970d115aef6d6ec03c6a6572e4ecc8b`.

**Lanes:** `flyway-exposed-parity-reviewer` (V028 triggers, Exposed twin, schema tests), `silent-failure-hunter` (Kotlin failure paths, bounds, cancellation, audit atomicity, edge gates), `code-reviewer` as tautology hunt (the eight changed test files, the two numeric fixes). Skipped `crypto-security-reviewer`: the failure-path lane covered the signing boundary this diff touched. Verifier: `critical-thinking` as the skeptic. Run as parallel read-only agents because this session has no `Workflow` tool.

**Verdict:** `MERGE-WITH-FIXES`. Scope verified (391da5d7 resolves; 26 files). Of 25 findings, 21 survive after merging duplicates (F8 into F21, F11 into F10, F13 with F22, F25 into F14); none is refuted outright, three are partially refuted and demoted (F2 escalation, F3, F9 per-process half, F19). One HIGH is a real code defect introduced by this diff: reject() now needs the DEA insert to succeed, so when the audit store is the thing that failed, REJECTED/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE cannot be recorded, the row stays PENDING, and spec FR-34 (line 271: 'if that append fails, end REJECTED AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE') is violated. One HIGH is a latent V028 defect (regrole identifier folding) that is fail-closed and unreachable in any documented environment; it needs V029 only if a non-lowercase owner is ever provisioned. One real MEDIUM bug: GET /withdrawable under the shipped merchant.toml (flag off, no CU knobs) throws IllegalArgumentException -> 500 after consuming a rate-limit slot. The rest are missing pins for safety-path fixes (SOL decimals, genesis refusal, route gates) and LOWs. Money direction is safe throughout (nothing is broadcast on any of these paths), so not BLOCK; withdrawalsEnabled must not flip until the five mustFix items land.

Raw findings: 25 (3 HIGH, 10 MEDIUM, 12 LOW). Refuted or demoted: 4. Confirmed after merge: 21 (2 HIGH, 9 MEDIUM, 10 LOW). Must fix before `withdrawalsEnabled` may flip, and fixed in the close-out PR: 5.
## Confirmed findings (most severe first)

### HIGH **MUST FIX**: reject() cannot record REJECTED when the audit insert is what failed (AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE is unpersistable; spec FR-34 violated)
- **Where:** Merchant/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/merchant/withdrawal/WithdrawalService.kt:1210-1228 (reject), 652-657 (SIGNING_ATTEMPT -> reject AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE), 853-856 (SIGNING_SUCCESS retry exhaustion), 975-990 (outer catch -> reject UNEXPECTED_ERROR); Merchant/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/merchant/db/PostgresWithdrawalStore.kt:471-496 (transitionAudited); WithdrawalReconciler.kt:333-340 (abandon also audited)
- **Failure path:** DEA append fails for a systemic reason (advisory lock timeout, chain-head contention, constraint on the record shape) -> service calls reject(AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE) -> transitionAudited runs UPDATE + appendInCurrentTransaction in one tx -> the append fails again -> rollback -> reject() throws 503 WITHDRAWAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE -> row stays PENDING holding the one-in-flight slot; the reason is only in a log line. The abandon sweep uses transitionAudited too, so during the outage the row never leaves PENDING; after recovery it ends WITHDRAWAL_ABANDONED, not AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE. Same for any tripwire/UNEXPECTED_ERROR rejection made while DEA is degraded. The AC-6_7 test hook throws only for SIGNING_ATTEMPT/SIGNING_SUCCESS; reject()'s SIGNING_FAILURE passes through the same beforeAppend hook untested. Production auditAppender is null (Main.kt:424-434).
- **Fix:** In reject() only: keep the atomic transitionAudited as the first attempt; if it throws, log ERROR with every audit field (withdrawalId, reason/auditReason, digest, wallet, amount) and fall back to store.transition(PENDING->REJECTED, TransitionFields(rejectReason = reason)); return Created(row) if that succeeds, else the existing 503. This leaves finding 6 intact on the normal path (atomic when the audit store works) and degrades only after the atomic attempt has demonstrably failed. Leave the reconciler abandon path atomic: it retries every pass and self-heals once DEA recovers. Add a WithdrawalSigningFailureTest case whose hook throws for SIGNING_FAILURE too, asserting the row is REJECTED/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE and that the ERROR line carries the digest. ponytail: upgrade path is a reconciler back-fill of the missing SIGNING_FAILURE row, which needs a marker column (V029).
- **Skeptic confirmed by:** Read reject(), transitionAudited, both AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE call sites, the outer catch, reconciler abandon, Main.kt wiring (auditLog and store share one `database`; auditAppender not passed), the AC-6_7 hook (SigningFailureTest:570-577, 623-627), and spec line 271. (lenses: failpaths, tests)

### HIGH: V028 owner check casts current_user to regrole, which folds identifiers; a non-lowercase or dotted owner role breaks the fixture escape with a different error (latent, fail-closed, permanent)
- **Where:** Aggro/src/main/resources/db/migration/V028__merchant_withdrawals.sql:40-42
- **Failure path:** current_user returns the raw role name; regrolein parses it as an unquoted identifier (downcases, splits on '.'). An owner named VistaOwner or a.b makes `current_user::regrole::oid` raise 'role does not exist' / 'invalid name syntax' whenever the IF is evaluated with the GUC on. In practice OR short-circuits on the GUC test, so production (GUC never set) sees only the intended cooling-off refusal; the fixture escape is the only victim. No documented environment has such an owner (compose `aggro`, Testcontainers `test`, deployment.md leaves the owner name to the operator).
- **Fix:** No action now. If a non-lowercase owner is ever provisioned: V029 CREATE OR REPLACE trg_fn_withdrawal_destinations_insert comparing `current_user` to `(SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE oid = (SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid = TG_RELID))`, or `to_regrole(quote_ident(current_user))`. Cheaper: one line in docs/guide/deployment.md requiring the owner role name to be a lowercase unquoted identifier.
- **Skeptic confirmed by:** Read V028:38-46 and the trigger list; checked deployment.md:570-620 and docker-compose.yml:26 for owner names; rated HIGH per the permanence rule (any V028 defect), demoted to canFixAfter because the failure is fail-closed and unreachable in every documented environment. (lenses: schema)

### MEDIUM **MUST FIX**: GET /withdrawable with the shipped merchant.toml (flag off, CU knobs unset) throws IllegalArgumentException -> opaque 500 after consuming a rate-limit slot
- **Where:** Merchant/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/merchant/withdrawal/WithdrawalService.kt:995-1011; Merchant/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/merchant/routes/WithdrawalRoutes.kt:224-238; config/merchant.toml:26-41; MerchantConfig.kt:122-124,214-231
- **Failure path:** The diff removed the flag guard from withdrawable() so ceiling reads work while writes are off. merchant.toml ships withdrawalsEnabled=false with no withdrawalComputeUnitLimit/withdrawalComputeUnitPriceMicroLamports; MerchantConfig defaults them to null and validates them only when the flag is true. The route consumes the per-DID slot (995-1004), then requireNotNull (1006) throws; the route catches only WithdrawalApiException. :app's StatusPages (EdgePlugins.kt) has no typed mapping for it, so the client gets a 500 with no token. Both pins (AdmissionTest:372, RoutesTest:280) set the CU knobs explicitly, so neither catches it.
- **Fix:** In withdrawable(), map a null CU knob to WithdrawalApiException(503, FEE_UNAVAILABLE) (or a new WITHDRAWAL_CONFIG_INCOMPLETE token) before taking the rate-limit slot; add one AdmissionTest case with baseConfig.copy(withdrawalsEnabled=false, withdrawalComputeUnitLimit=null, withdrawalComputeUnitPriceMicroLamports=null) asserting the token.
- **Skeptic confirmed by:** Read withdrawable() head, MerchantConfig validation, merchant.toml, WithdrawalRoutes catch, RoutesTest mount config (lines 70-72 set the knobs), Main.kt (service is wired whenever rpc+resolver exist, flag irrelevant). (lenses: failpaths)

### MEDIUM **MUST FIX**: Finding 1 (SOL decimals from the resolver) has no pinning test; reverting to a literal 9 stays green (tracer also hardcodes the WSOL mint string)
- **Where:** WithdrawalService.kt:470-479,1073-1079; privy-harness/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/merchant/harness/WithdrawalTracer.kt:91-92; WithdrawalServiceAdmissionTest.kt:106-111,367-384
- **Failure path:** Every withdrawal test resolver maps WRAPPED_SOL_MINT to 9 (AdmissionTest:109, SigningTest:127, SigningFailureTest:109, LogRedactionTest:110); the only failing resolver throws for every mint, and withdrawable() resolves SOL before USDC so a dropped SOL call still yields DECIMALS_UNAVAILABLE from the USDC call. movePointLeft(9) is byte-identical to movePointLeft(solDecimals) under these fakes.
- **Fix:** One AdmissionTest case wiring a resolver with WRAPPED_SOL_MINT to 8 asserting withdrawable() available/reserve/sweepAmount are scaled by 8 and that request() hands the simulation fake ExpectedDeltas at the 8 scale; one case with a resolver that throws only for WSOL asserting DECIMALS_UNAVAILABLE / SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE. Tracer: reference SwapAmountBinding.WRAPPED_SOL_MINT (privy-harness already depends on :merchant, build.gradle.kts:41).
- **Skeptic confirmed by:** grep of Merchant/src/test for SOL resolver values shows only 9; read both scaling sites and the tracer; checked privy-harness deps. (lenses: tests)

## Refuted or demoted

- **F2's claim that a permanent audit failure on one SUBMITTED row never escalates** (failpaths): WithdrawalReconciler.kt:116-124 logs `withdrawal_stuck` at ERROR every pass once the row is SUBMITTED longer than withdrawalSubmittedAlarmMs (600 s in merchant.toml), and the per-row catch logs `withdrawal_reconcile_row_failed` at ERROR every pass. Escalation exists; only a counter is missing. Demoted to LOW.
- **F9's 'per-process only' limiter objection and Q4** (failpaths): docs/specs/2026-10-22-withdrawal-spec.md:182 specifies 'an in-process token bucket per JVM' for withdrawalRpcRoutesPerMinute; per-process is the design, not a gap.
- **Schema lane residual: the SUBMISSION audit append can be lost silently after store.submit** (schema): By design: spec lines 157 and 273 make the SUBMISSION append best-effort ('a failure logs ERROR with the signature and never turns the 201 into an error'); SIGNING_SUCCESS (line 156) is the required pre-broadcast evidence and is enforced at WithdrawalService.kt:842-856.
- **F4's premise that Merchant has no StatusPages handler** (failpaths): Partially wrong: :app installs StatusPages in app/src/main/kotlin/com/vista/app/EdgePlugins.kt (Aggro 429 and Maker exceptions). It does not change the outcome (no typed token for IllegalArgumentException), so the finding itself stands.
